text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One sunny day over at Miho Dormitory...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, now to finish the job with a
quick spray
down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Where did that hose get off to... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Looks like someone's swapped the hose out for a toy snake.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what gives?! What kinda half-baked
reaction
was that, Hishiama?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! So this was your doing after all,
Windy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We've all gotten used to your pranks by
now. I
mean, it's hard not to when
they're all so similar.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Th-that can't be true! I just know my
pranks get
everyone real good! They've
gotta!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Graaah! Start running, 'cause I'm gonna
get'cha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You lookin' for a high five or
something?
'Cause I'd be glad to oblige!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha! I've swapped your Japanese
textbook
for an elementary school-level
one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow, this takes me back! I loved the
story
about the Umamusume who
wanted to be a
soccer player.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I filled the pool with a bunch of rubber
ducks! It's
gonna shock everyone outta
their skin for sure!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at all these rubber duckies!
Let's all
swim together, duckies!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What the heck? No one was surprised by my pranks... I think they actually enjoyed them!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You know, it really goes to show that
you've
gotta switch things up every now
and again to
keep things fresh.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Agreed! Even my favorite training
regimen gets
stale after a while.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We've all gotten used to your pranks by
now. I
mean, it's hard not to when
they're all so similar.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-No way! Are my pranks getting stale?! Does everyone think I'm a joke?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fine, then! That just means I've gotta
pull off a
prank so major, it'll have
Hishiama shivering in
her boots!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna whip up the perfect plan and
give
everyone the scare of their lives!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy proudly boasts of her
dastardly scheme. The devious glint in
her eyes makes her
look just like a
demon lord.
